<subject>Draft of Network Leadership Handover Memo to David Larsen</subject>
<body>
David,   As we just discussed, this is the handover memo suggesting you connect with Stephen Mclaughlin.   As noted, we’re still finalizing with Regulatory the leave policy for staff seconded to the private infrastructure taskforce versus the publicly funded broadband initiative.  The outcome could impact their availability, in certain cases.  
</body>
